recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，以大量核圓而深染、周圍帶透亮暈及粉紅細胞質的幼紅血球為主（紅血球系增生），其中可見數個雙核的晚期幼紅血球；紅系增生合併雙核為 CDA type II 的表現。
features: Hypercellular marrow with marked erythroid hyperplasia
Numerous late erythroblasts with small round, dense hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear clearing
Scattered binucleated erythroblasts with paired round nuclei
Early erythroid precursors with open chromatin and nucleoli admixed
Relatively few granulocytic precursors; red cells present in sinusoids
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy is hypercellular with marked erythroid hyperplasia, composed predominantly of erythroblasts with round hyperchromatic nuclei and perinuclear halos, together with earlier forms showing open chromatin. Scattered binucleated late erythroblasts are identified. Granulocytic elements are relatively diminished and no infiltrative process is seen. In the appropriate clinical context, findings are consistent with congenital dyserythropoietic anemia type II; binuclearity is better appreciated on the aspirate smear.

ddx.dx: Hemolytic anemia with reactive erythroid hyperplasia
ddx.vs: Reactive erythroid hyperplasia lacks conspicuous binucleated late erythroblasts.
Pure erythroid leukemia consists of sheets of immature proerythroblasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli, whereas here maturing late erythroblasts predominate.
Megaloblastic marrow shows large erythroblasts with open sieve-like chromatin and giant metamyelocytes, not small dense binucleated late normoblasts.
CDA I shows megaloblastoid erythroblasts with internuclear chromatin bridges, requiring aspirate or EM to distinguish.
